signature.one_line: One evolving black dot-grid diagram above a rounded face card, single-word captions, italic-serif title word, full-face cuts for opinions.
unique_devices: A single diagram (year timeline -> branching category tree -> second accent 'hero' nodes) that evolves for the whole video and pans/scrolls with motion blur
Captions strictly one word at a time (hard swap, no gaps, no colour), between panel and face card at 66.4 % H
Speaker 'steps out' of the diagram to a full-face CU/MCU for every opinion line (~30 % of runtime), with crop size changing between full-face shots
accent keyword CTA bar ('Comment "KEYWORD" / To Get The Doc') over a grid of document thumbnails
signature.why_it_works: The viewer builds one mental model that grows with the argument; the face never leaves the screen and dense 207-wpm speech carries the pace while the panel animates.

hook.first_frame: split: light-grey grid panel with a two-line title (one italic serif phrase) and a 3x3 grid of example content thumbnails popping in with second accent view-count badges; the speaker in a rounded card at the bottom, one-word caption between

structure.what: promise of a new category over a wall of examples with numbers, then full-face cut naming it in italic serif
history: timeline scroll with two then three branches, example profile grids; full-face beats for asides
new section title; the tree splits into three new branches as the speaker says it
define each branch: pan to one node per category, full-face shots for the opinion on each
carousel of concrete formats under the winning node; full-face authority line
recap on the full tree with three second accent hero nodes
accent keyword banner over document thumbnails (lead magnet)

pacing.notes: few cuts (9.2/min) but the panel animates continuously (scrolls, pans, pop-ins), so something changes every ~48-72 frames; 79 % of cuts read as soft (layout swaps); speech covers ~100 % of runtime

captions.how: Inter 700, 58 px centred at y 66.4 % on splits, 68 px at y 63 % on full-face; hard 1-frame swap per word, no gap, no emphasis

background_text.what: two-line section title with one italic serif word
background_text.when: every split shot, changes per section
background_text.how: Inter 700 52 px -0.02em white, top centre y 7 % / 9.8 %; key word in thin italic serif at the same cap height

background_text.when: full-face shot right after the hook and when a concept is named
background_text.how: Playfair/Garamond italic ~75 px, x ~18-54 %, centre y 63.5 %

motion_graphics.how: horizontal timeline with accent node dots scrolls to new years with directional motion blur (~10-14 frames, power2.inOut); branches grow from nodes; camera pans node to node

motion_graphics.what: pop-in example cards with view badges
motion_graphics.how: rounded thumbnails scale 0.9 -> 1 with slight overshoot (back.out ~1.4) over ~8 frames, second accent badges pop after

cards_lists.how: small black pills with thin white outline on the tree; winners turn second accent in the recap
cards slide horizontally under the winning node

broll_inserts.how: inside the graphic panel, never full-screen

layout.what: split: graphic panel over rounded face card
layout.how: panel y 0-70 % on black dot grid; face card x 6-94 %, y ~73-100 %, radius ~4 % W
CU low angle alternating with MCU; used for opinions and transitions

camera.what: static studio camera, crop changes between full-face shots
camera.how: CU (low angle) vs MCU as punch-in substitute about every 10-15 % of runtime

transitions.what: layout swaps and animated panel moves
transitions.how: swap between split and full-face on sentence boundaries (L-trail), no flashy transitions

end_card.how: 'Comment "KEYWORD"' (italic serif keyword) + accent bar 'To Get The Doc' at y 8-14.5 % over document thumbnails; no separate logo card

case.caption: as spoken (lowercase mid-sentence, capital at sentence start), punctuation kept (trailing commas / full stops stay on the word)

grouping.sync: word by word on the spoken word
grouping.break: each word replaces the previous one; it holds until the next word starts (no empty gaps while speaking)

layout.split_layout: graphic panel top (y 0-70 %), rounded face card bottom (x 6-94 %, y ~73-100 %, radius ~4 % W); the word is centred horizontally with its centre at y 66.4 % (in the gap above the face card)
layout.full_face: word centred horizontally, centre y 63.0 % (over the chest)

caption_split.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, round e with horizontal bar, t with slanted cut, tight apertures; same proportions as Inter (height and width agree within 3 %)
caption_split.shadow: soft dark shadow, estimated 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5) (barely visible on black)

caption_full.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, bold (same face, larger on full-face shots)
caption_full.shadow: soft dark shadow, estimated 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5) (barely visible on black)

title.color: #FFFFFF on the black grid panel; near-black #0A090A on the light-grey #E0DFDF hook panel
title.calibration_note: a 5-word Title Case line measured ink 1.95 % H and ~53 % W; compute expected ink for the user's title with fit_font.py
title.position: top, centred; line 1 centre y 7.0 %, line 2 centre y 9.8 % (line pitch 2.8 % H), width 50-62 % W
title.emphasis: one or two words per title swapped into a thin italic serif at the same cap height (the adjective / verb that carries the promise)

closest_match.google: EB Garamond Italic / Instrument Serif Italic

serif.letterform_evidence: calligraphic italic with thin hairlines, teardrop terminals on a and c, long descender on p, lighter than Playfair
serif.calibration_note: a 1-word concept name measured ink 3.91 % H, 35 % W; compute expected ink for the user's word with fit_font.py
serif.use: the name of the concept on a full-face shot (x ~18-54 %, centre y 63.5 %, left of centre) and the italic word inside titles

animation.entry: hard cut: the new word replaces the old one in a single frame, no fade/scale/slide

animation.exit: hard cut, replaced by the next word; the last word of a sentence holds until the next word starts

big white bold years / step labels (ink 3.59 % H, centre y 55.7 %) on a horizontal timeline with red #AD1217 node dots; category labels in small black pill boxes with a thin white outline; black panel with a faint dot grid; final 'hero' nodes turn green
rounded content thumbnails / profile grids with green #117210 view-count badges ('1.2M') and small white caption chips; pop in with a slight overshoot

'Comment' white bold + '“KEYWORD”' italic serif (line ink 3.36 % H, x 20-81 %, centre y 8 %), then 'To Get The Doc' white bold on a solid red #B8070B bar (text ink 2.89 % H, x 24-75 %, bar x 20-80 %, y ~10.5-14.5 %) over a grid of document-page thumbnails

optional light pop on example-card pop-ins

use_when: an explainer of a framework, category map, evolution or taxonomy
one speaker in a dark studio with lots of dense speech
the idea can be one diagram that grows through the video
the CTA is a downloadable doc / comment keyword
the user wants the face on screen the whole time

brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B12 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B12.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} on {{SURFACE}} >= 7:1, {{ACCENT}} dots/bar >= 3:1 on {{SURFACE}}, white text on the {{ACCENT}} bar >= 4.5:1)
- {{TEXT}} captions, titles, years - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} timeline dots, CTA bar - default red #B8070B (dots #AD1217)
- {{ACCENT_2}} view badges, final 'hero' nodes - default green #117210
- {{SURFACE}} graphic panel - default near-black #050505 with a faint dot grid
- {{CARD_BG}} light hook panel - default light grey #E0DFDF (text near-black #0A090A)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} accent word in titles / concept names - default italic old-style serif (Instrument Serif Italic or EB Garamond Italic; local stand-in Playfair Display 400 italic)
- {{FONT_BODY}} captions, titles, labels - default Inter 700 (Bold)
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle (optional, small under the CTA)
- {{LOGO}} - not required; optional small mark on the CTA panel

Canvas 1080x1920, 24 fps.

LAYOUT
1. Split for ~70 % of runtime: graphic panel y 0-70 % on {{SURFACE}}; speaker in a rounded face card x 6-94 %, y ~73-100 %, radius ~4 % W. Full-face CU/MCU for every opinion or aside (~30 %, 38-180 frames each), alternating crop sizes.
2. One diagram for the whole video: a horizontal timeline with {{ACCENT}} node dots and big {{TEXT}} bold labels (ink 3.59 % H, centre y 55.7 %) that scrolls with directional motion blur (~10-14 frames, power2.inOut); branches grow into a category tree of small black pills with thin white outlines; pan node to node as each is discussed; recap with the winners in {{ACCENT_2}}.
3. Example cards (rounded thumbnails, {{ACCENT_2}} count badges like '1.2M') pop in with back.out(1.4) over ~8 frames.

CAPTIONS
4. Latin script, as spoken, punctuation kept; exactly ONE word on screen at a time; hard 1-frame swap on each spoken word, no fade, no gap, no colour emphasis.
5. {{FONT_BODY}}, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke/box, soft shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5). Splits: 58 px, centred, centre y 66.4 % (gap above the face card). Full-face: 68 px, centre y 63 %.

OTHER TEXT
6. Section title on every split: two centred Title Case lines 'Headline here / Second line here', {{FONT_BODY}} 52 px, -0.02em, {{TEXT}} (near-black on {{CARD_BG}}), line centres y 7.0 % and 9.8 %, width 50-62 % W; one or two key words swapped to {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at the same cap height. Title changes per section.
7. Concept name on the full-face shot after the hook: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~75 px (verify width), x ~18-54 %, centre y 63.5 %.
8. Hook frame 1: {{CARD_BG}} panel with the title and a 3x3 grid of example thumbnails popping in, count badges by frame ~36; first cut to full-face at ~3 % of runtime.
9. CTA (last ~8 %): 'Comment' {{FONT_BODY}} + '"KEYWORD"' {{FONT_DISPLAY}} (ink 3.36 % H, x 20-81 %, centre y 8 %), then 'To Get The Doc' {{TEXT}} bold (ink 2.89 % H) on a solid {{ACCENT}} bar x 20-80 %, y 10.5-14.5 %, over a grid of document-page thumbnails.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: dark low-key studio, high-contrast, muted, warm lamp bokeh, cool desaturated shadows.
SOUND: voice only at about -14 LUFS (keep true peak <= -1 dBTP); optional soft whoosh on timeline scrolls.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Inter; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames over {{SURFACE}}: "education" ({{FONT_BODY}} 58 px), "video" ({{FONT_BODY}} 68 px), a two-line test title "Headline here" (52 px) and "KEY WORD" in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 75 px.
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.3,0.645,0.7,0.685 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" (split caption); --box 0.3,0.605,0.7,0.65 (full-face caption); --box 0.15,0.055,0.85,0.083 (title line 1); --box 0.15,0.6,0.6,0.655 --ink "{{TEXT}}:70" (serif word).
c) Required: "education" ink 2.19 % +-0.5 of H and 24.6 % +-2 of W; "video" 2.58 % +-0.5 and 15.7 % +-2. For the title and serif word compute expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<font>" --word "<word>" at the px above (serif target cap-to-descender ink ~3.9 % H for a 1-word name).
